title: Cercospora Leaf spot on African Eggplant and Nightshade

Header: Cercospora Leaf spot on African Eggplant and Nightshade

Prevention: Rotate with non-Solanacous species such as maize and beans.
Contact local sellers for resistant varieties available in your area.
Remove weeds from within and around the garden.
Remove and destroy severely diseased leaves and plants by burning/burying.
Intercrop with other vegetables to interrupt pathogen transmission.
Maintain recommended spacing between plants (50 cm x 75 cm).
Do not work with wet plants as movement can disperse fungal spores.
Add compost manure to the field.
Monitoring: Monitor the field frequently and look for plants with chlorotic lesions, angular to irregular in shape.
These later turn greyish brown with sporulation at the centre of the spot.
Direct Control: Apply appropriate protective copper based fungicides.
